base_source.policy: Within all four experts and seven repeats use the same saved starting tensors, including classifier head. Do not create independent heads and average them.
base_source.limitation: Base already trained on the original 482 rows. Seven seeds do not represent seven fresh base-model initializations.

training.initialization: All 66 tensors including classifier loaded from the same saved seed43 checkpoint; fresh optimizer for each job
training.training_stream: Every unique shared row once, then focus rows and linked contrast rows once more; concatenate before the normal seeded training shuffle. No replacement sampling and no third copy.
training.checkpoint_selection: Development macro F1 descending, loss ascending, earlier epoch
training.rationale: Keep the prior specialist pilot learning rate 1e-5; allow 10 epochs for the new 336 rows and choose the epoch by dev, as in the earlier Colab training

merge_scope: All 66 float32 tensors including classifier; experts ordered spatial, mount, sword, mob
arithmetic_formula: base + scale * sum(expert - base); scale .25 is the equal mean of four experts, up to floating-point roundoff
ties_formula: base + scale * TIES(expert - base); concatenate all tensors sorted by name; per-model global top20 percent, mass sign election, dis-mean

ties_reference.reuse: Previously archived author source; execute only four inspected pure functions

seven_seed_weight_mean: For each of the four experts and five merge recipes, equally average its seven checkpoints; separately evaluate all nine resulting models
selection: Rank all 73 candidates by dev macro F1 descending, loss ascending, declared candidate order; freeze before test. Also select best trained single and best four-expert merge by the same rule. Pick recipe by seven-seed mean dev macro F1, mean dev loss, declared recipe order.
test_policy: Evaluate all 73 fixed candidates only after dev selection is frozen; no changes based on test
train_diagnostics: Evaluate unique selected candidates plus baseline on shared 818 rows; identify added 336 rows separately; not heldout accuracy
evaluation_scope: Existing dev 46 / test 50 were already used in material design; diagnostic only. No new independent heldout or real-world accuracy evidence created.

runtime_environment.reproducibility: Record GPU, CUDA, package versions, seeds, hashes and deterministic mode. Different GPU/driver versions can still produce different floating-point results.
